machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.
machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 with Max-Q Design, 6144 MiB, 580.97

protocol.argument: registered ModelInstance pytree (tree_map(jnp.asarray, instance_from_vector)) for every route; fwd = jax.jacfwd over its scalar leaves (the flat parameter vector)
protocol.gate_draws: prior medians + PRNGKey 0..15 U(0.25,0.75) unit draws
protocol.hessian_patch: scoped monkeypatch of LensCalc._hessian_via_jax; trace/lower/compile inside the scope; restore asserted; trace-call counter > 0; StableHLO hashes distinct
protocol.cache_trap_guard: fresh closure + fresh AnalysisPoint per route; jax.clear_caches()
protocol.solver: solver=None; FitPositionsSource never invokes a PointSolver
protocol.pytrees: autofit.jax.register_model(model) for both lanes before any trace

hessian_gate.mapping: H_xx = kappa + gamma_1, H_yy = kappa - gamma_1, H_xy = H_yx = gamma_2 with shear_yx_2d_from[:, 0] = gamma_2, [:, 1] = gamma_1 (no sign flips)

library_formula_parity.what: in-cell traceable kappa/gamma vs Isothermal.convergence_2d_from / shear_yx_2d_from (eager, xp=np), error scaled by |kappa|

phase2c_rule.rule: GO iff saved >= 0.05 ms AND >= 15% vs rev on the value_and_grad-equivalent call, 90% CIs excluding the bar (saved CI low >= 0.05 ms, ratio CI high <= 0.85), correctness gate green
